Content: Genes control the inheritance of traits. Some genes are dominant and some are recessive. Some are neither dominant nor recessive, such as the genes that control flower color in a certain species of plant. In this species, a plant with red flowers inherits `text(two)` genes for red `(R R)`, a plant with white flowers inherits `text(two)` genes for white `(WW)`, and a plant with pink flowers inherits `text(one)` gene for red and `text(one)` gene for white `(RW)`.
